name: artifactory_credential_recognizer
note: JFrog Artifactory API token (AKC…) and encrypted password (AP…). Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/artifactory.py. The original requires whitespace/=/:/" around the value; here \b is used instead. The password form (AP + hex digit/A-F + 8+ alphanumerics) is generic, so it scores low unless 'artifactory' or 'jfrog' appears nearby.
